content.text: Logs are mostly background noise, so I'll go back to the traces and compute self-time per span name, separating each service's own work from its child calls.

input.query: WITH srv AS (SELECT span_id, trace_id, duration::BIGINT d, CAST(floor((epoch(time) - (SELECT min(epoch(time)) FROM abnormal_traces))/30) AS INT) hm FROM abnormal_traces WHERE service_name='ts-basic-service' AND attr_span_kind='Server'), internal AS (SELECT i.parent_span_id psid, i.trace_id, i.span_id isid, i.duration::BIGINT id FROM abnormal_traces i WHERE i.service_name='ts-basic-service' AND i.attr_span_kind='Internal'), cl AS (SELECT c.parent_span_id, c.trace_id, c.duration::BIGINT cd, c.service_name csvc FROM abnormal_traces c WHERE c.attr_span_kind='Client') SELECT s.hm, count(*) n, round(quantile_cont(s.d,0.5)/1e6,1) srv_p50, round(quantile_cont(i.id,0.5)/1e6,1) ctrl_p50, round(quantile_cont(coalesce(c.cs,0),0.5)/1e6,1) client_sum_p50, round(quantile_cont(i.id - coalesce(c.cs,0),0.5)/1e6,1) ctrl_self_p50 FROM srv s LEFT JOIN internal i ON i.psid=s.span_id AND i.trace_id=s.trace_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT parent_span_id, trace_id, sum(cd) cs FROM cl GROUP BY 1,2) c ON c.parent_span_id=i.isid AND c.trace_id=i.trace_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
